# strada

Version: 0.8.0

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`database create`](./database-create.mdx) | Create a Strada database on your own Tinybird workspace. |
| [`database upgrade`](./database-upgrade.mdx) | Upgrade the Tinybird schema to the latest version. |
| [`login`](./login.mdx) | Authenticate with Strada via browser-based device flow. |
| [`logout`](./logout.mdx) | Remove stored authentication from ~/.strada/config.json. |
| [`whoami`](./whoami.mdx) | Show the currently authenticated user and server URL. |
| [`orgs list`](./orgs-list.mdx) | List all organizations you belong to. |
| [`setup`](./setup.mdx) | Save the default organization and project for the current folder. |
| [`projects list`](./projects-list.mdx) | List all projects in the current organization. |
| [`projects create`](./projects-create.mdx) | Create a new project and generate its first org-wide ingest token. |
| [`projects delete`](./projects-delete.mdx) | Delete a project by its ID. |
| [`projects retention`](./projects-retention.mdx) | Show raw telemetry retention for a project. |
| [`projects retention update`](./projects-retention-update.mdx) | Update raw telemetry retention for a project. |
| [`issues list`](./issues-list.mdx) | List error issue groups sorted by frequency. |
| [`issues view`](./issues-view.mdx) | Show full details for a single issue by fingerprint hash. |
| [`issues resolve`](./issues-resolve.mdx) | Mark an issue as resolved. |
| [`issues mute`](./issues-mute.mdx) | Mark an issue as muted. |
| [`issues unresolve`](./issues-unresolve.mdx) | Reopen a resolved or muted issue. |
| [`issues assign`](./issues-assign.mdx) | Assign an issue to an org member or remove the current assignee. |
| [`analytics pages`](./analytics-pages.mdx) | Top pages by pageviews from the otel_analytics_pages materialized view. |
| [`analytics browsers`](./analytics-browsers.mdx) | Top browsers by unique visitors |
| [`analytics devices`](./analytics-devices.mdx) | Top device types by unique visitors |
| [`analytics countries`](./analytics-countries.mdx) | Top countries by unique visitors |
| [`analytics referrers`](./analytics-referrers.mdx) | Top traffic sources by unique visitors |
| [`analytics languages`](./analytics-languages.mdx) | Top browser languages by unique visitors |
| [`analytics kpis`](./analytics-kpis.mdx) | Summary KPIs: unique visitors, pageviews, sessions, bounce rate, and |
| [`analytics overview`](./analytics-overview.mdx) | One-screen browser analytics: unique visitors, pageviews, sessions, |
| [`analytics timeseries`](./analytics-timeseries.mdx) | Daily unique visitors and pageviews. |
| [`analytics visitors`](./analytics-visitors.mdx) | Unique visitors, first visits, and returning visitors. |
| [`analytics events`](./analytics-events.mdx) | Top custom events by occurrence count |
| [`analytics realtime`](./analytics-realtime.mdx) | Count active visitors in the last 5 minutes. |
| [`query`](./query.mdx) | Run a ClickHouse SQL query against a project's database. |
| [`alerts create`](./alerts-create.mdx) | Create an error alert rule. |
| [`alerts list`](./alerts-list.mdx) | Show all alert rules and destinations for the current org. |
| [`alerts update`](./alerts-update.mdx) | Update an error alert rule's settings. |
| [`alerts delete`](./alerts-delete.mdx) | Delete an error alert rule. |
| [`alerts test`](./alerts-test.mdx) | Send a test alert to all destinations in the org. |
| [`checks create`](./checks-create.mdx) | Create a URL health check that runs on a schedule. |
| [`checks list`](./checks-list.mdx) | List all health checks for the current org. |
| [`checks delete`](./checks-delete.mdx) | Delete a health check by ID. |
| [`checks enable`](./checks-enable.mdx) | Re-enable a health check that was disabled (manually or auto-disabled). |
| [`checks disable`](./checks-disable.mdx) | Manually disable a health check. |
| [`destinations list`](./destinations-list.mdx) | List all notification destinations for the current org. |
| [`destinations remove`](./destinations-remove.mdx) | Remove a notification destination. |
| [`logs`](./logs.mdx) | Browse and search OTel log records from otel_logs. |
| [`services list`](./services-list.mdx) | Find service names that are actively generating logs or traces. |
| [`traces list`](./traces-list.mdx) | List distributed traces in a project, grouped by TraceId. |
| [`traces span`](./traces-span.mdx) | Show the full details for one span inside a trace. |
| [`traces view`](./traces-view.mdx) | Render one distributed trace as a parent-child span tree. |
| [`tokens create`](./tokens-create.mdx) | Create an org-wide token with an explicit scope. |
| [`tokens list`](./tokens-list.mdx) | List org-wide tokens. |
| [`tokens delete`](./tokens-delete.mdx) | Delete an org-wide token. |
| [`mcp`](./mcp.mdx) | Start a stdio MCP server that exposes supported non-interactive Strada |
